revisions.arc: arc-b7-v2 (books/book-07-void-roads/CHAPTER_ARCHITECTURE.md, editor PASS r4, Chapter 21 card)

knowledge_boundary: Cael is nineteen; ten + anomaly. Party SIX. Brom one-shouldered (mended twice? No: mended once at the Stair; it REOPENS here on the wall and is mended again outside the line); Lira one-armed. Three days along the kit's bearing; the carter's map's third circle exactly where the bearing said.

The site: a hall — walls of the grey stone to shoulder height, roofless, half-drowned by a spring that broke through the floor and made a shallow lake inside; the perimeter's two hundred meters holding a circle of marsh around it; one old stake at the line, the ground around it churned. Something large lives under the hall.

THE WOLD-WYRM taught before it is fought, from OUTSIDE the line over an afternoon (charter fairness law): the spring's surface moving wrong; a stake at the hall's lip bent from below; Oryn's carters' word for it; Karis's stone trials (a head-sized stone dropped in the shallows — the water answers AT the stone, not at the wall; a second, further — same); Seln's finding entered on Karis's page: blind; reads weight on the floor; strikes where the weight is; strikes WHAT STAYS (a stone that lands and settles is hit; a stone that skips is ignored). And Cael's trial, from the wall's top, Karis timing: an Anchor-adjacent fixed point laid on the flooded floor twenty paces out (the binding from the Ostrand road, which fixes a point AGAINST the surface it is laid on) — the water answers at the point and keeps answering after every stone has gone quiet, because a fixed point is weight that never stops arriving. Karis: 'It reads that as the heaviest thing on the floor.' Cael, releasing it: 'It reads that as the thing that stays.' The winning mechanism, cold-tested.

The fight in water in the Quiet: FIRST the wyrm comes up under Brom (heaviest; he STOPPED to give Karis a shoulder up the wall); its shape in pieces (blind, armored, jawed length). SECOND the walls as terrain (shoulder-high cover and trap; knee-deep water then deep at the broken center; the wyrm cannot leave the water and cannot see); Seln: 'It's blind. It reads the floor. Get OFF the floor.'; six on a wall-top; Karis copying carvings from the wall she stands on (funny for exactly one paragraph). THIRD the cost: Oryn into the water because Brom's shoulder opened and he is on the wrong wall and slipping — a healer who cannot heal here reaching a falling patient — and she keeps MOVING, skipping-stone, so the first pass misses; the second will not. FOURTH the turn: Cael into the water declaring — Compression-adjacent to take the first strike on himself instead of her; then Anchor-adjacent laid on the floor at the broken center, one fixed point of held pressure, the thing that stays hardest; the wyrm surfaces at it, whole for the first time in anyone's memory, jaws on stone that does not give; Brom from the wall puts his weight where Cael says; Seln and Lira (one-armed, a crossbow braced) put two bolts each into the pale underside the strike exposes, at contact range. It does not die; it lets go of a floor that stopped answering and goes under and does not come up. Win: Cael took away the wyrm's choice of target by giving the floor one point that never moved.
The TENTH fragment (Tide-adjacent) is NOT used in the fight, on the wyrm or anyone.

Costs outside the line: Brom's shoulder mended a second time; Oryn drained, silent a long while; Cael spent; the walls copied. Oryn's clinical register breaks for the first time: 'You went in the water.' 'You went in for Brom.' 'Brom's on my route.' A pause. 'So are you.'
No theory; no 'Architect'; the wyrm is an animal (no Path, no mind).

purpose: REPAIR RUN. Apply the seven verified findings to v3-runs/book-07/drafts/ch21-r1.md: (001) trials staged from the hall's outer coping inside the perimeter under EXC-B7-005, with the crossing, the dusk return and the first-light entry onto the floor staged; (002) the wyrm water-bound throughout (the mud heaved from beneath); (003) the hall twelve strides square; (004) two pre-spanned bows for Lira and a spanned second shot for Seln, four hits; (005) five days; (006) the reserve matched to one mending; (007) the Iron read billed. No other passage changes; wc within band.

scene_shape.opening_state: The Drowned Hall from the marsh at the line; the stake; the churned ground; the afternoon's trials from outside.
scene_shape.pov_goal: Learn the thing under the floor before entering; copy the walls; keep six people alive on a flooded floor where only he works.
scene_shape.opposition: A blind pressure-hunter in water; walls that are cover and trap; the healer's instinct to reach a falling patient.
scene_shape.turn: The trials (stones; Seln's rule; Cael's Anchor point cold-tested). Lira's 'Just checking that's the plan.' exchange with Karis. The entry; the wyrm under Brom; the walls; Oryn into the water.
scene_shape.choice: Cael into the water declaring; Compression for the first strike; the fixed point at the broken center.
scene_shape.outcome: The wyrm whole at the point; Brom's weight; four bolts into the underside; it goes under; the unit leaves it; walls copied. Costs and Oryn's broken register outside the line.
scene_shape.closing_state: The chapter ENDS ON DIALOGUE (the previous chapter ended on the log), Oryn's line: 'Lie still. I want to read you.'

must_include: The wyrm taught from outside over an afternoon with ALL the listed trials (surface moving; bent stake; the carters' word via Oryn; two stone drops; Seln's strike-what-stays rule entered on Karis's page; Cael's Anchor point trial with Karis's and Cael's fixed lines).
Lira/Karis exchange verbatim before entry ('We're going in without Paths to look at walls with a thing under the floor.' / 'Yes.' / 'Just checking that's the plan.').

Four exchanges as staged with the walls, the water depths, and the broken center as terrain; at least two beats CAUSED by terrain; geography drawable; the wyrm's shape in pieces, never whole until it surfaces at the point.
Oryn's entry into the water staged as a healer reaching a patient, not heroism; her skipping-stone movement per the rule; the second pass imminent.
Cael's turn with the fragments named (Compression; Anchor at the center); Brom's weight; Seln's and Lira's bolts into the underside; the wyrm not killed; the win legible.
Costs outside the line (Brom's second mending; Oryn drained; Cael spent); Oryn's register breaking with the fixed exchange; the chapter ENDS on 'Lie still. I want to read you.'
The tenth fragment used on no one in this chapter.
Manuscript format: H1 '# Chapter 21 — The Drowned Hall', prose only, '---' breaks, ends on the last line of prose.
plants: Three sets of carvings and a straightedge (Ch22–23).
Oryn: 'So are you.' (the route includes him; Ch23–24).
payoffs: Ch20's bearing; B6 Ch13's fixed-point binding; B2's Compression; Ch19's 'no column'.
prohibited_outcomes: The wyrm is not killed; nobody dies; injuries only as listed.
No tenth-fragment use; no reading of the wyrm; no untaught mechanism decides anything.
No theory; the wyrm has no Path/mind.
No Teague (his crew stayed at the Stair/Oxhollow); no letters, Vastin.
The chapter does not end on a log entry or an image.
No modern idiom; no feeling/growth declarations; tic caps; no metadata.
Do not use the phrase 'at the pitch' (or 'at that pitch') — it is at the book's cap already (10 uses in Chapters 1–4). Vary attribution registers with other means.

allowed: The marsh, the spring's water, the hall's walls and carvings, the wyrm's armor and pale underside, the sound of water answering a stone, lamplight, cold; each companion's fight-style; the funny paragraph.
Dialogue in established voices beyond the fixed lines (short).
Cael's cataloguing under pressure and in the trials.
approval_required: Any new named entity; any wyrm behavior beyond blind/pressure/strikes-what-stays/water-bound; any new fragment mechanic; any injury change.
forbidden: Killing the wyrm; tenth-fragment use; untaught mechanisms; theory; a log or image ending; metadata.
